description:
About the company
 Our client is a healthcare technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Take full ownership of a young company's technical base, covering the user-facing application, server-side services, data protection and machine learning models. Work directly with the company's leadership as the first engineering hire, shaping architecture, engineering practices and team culture from the start.
 What you'll do
 - Own the full technical stack across the user-facing app, backend services and data models.
 - Build and release server interfaces and data flows that people use daily.
 - Build security and data protection into systems from the first line of code.
 - Work across Python and TypeScript services to deliver features end to end.
 - Contribute to machine learning models and bring them into live products.
 - Set up engineering processes and help define the team's technical culture.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - A track record of building and launching server-side interfaces and data flows that customers depend on.
 - Experience as an engineer on a health-tech product used by patients or clinicians.
 - A record of owning work from design through delivery, with evidence of what you have shipped.
 - Comfort working directly with company leadership, making decisions with limited structure and moving quickly.
 - A habit of verifying work carefully, including when using AI tools to speed it up.
 Bonus points
 - A degree from a top computer science school, or medals from international olympiads in informatics or mathematics.
 - Experience shipping LLM features, machine learning operations, or health data integrations such as HL7 or FHIR.
 - Experience as an engineer at a leading AI or consumer health company.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: $200K - $300K
 - Equity
 - Relocation assistance
 Location and work model
 - Boston, MA, United States
 - On-site
 - Full-time
